thread:
maria-csr: Customer reported intermittent empty embeddings from /v1/embeddings. Happens ~1-2% of calls, mostly under load. Customer says SDK retries duplicate requests and billing spiked. Ticket #C-9931.

sam-engineer: Oof. Do we have a repro or raw request/response?

maria-csr: Pasting sanitized example from customer logs: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-1.1",
  "input": ["hello", "world"]
}
```
Response (intermittent): 200 OK but embeddings: `[[], []]` or vectors of length 0. Sometimes one vector is correct and other empty.

jonathan-go: That matches a raced write path we saw in the Go SDK batcher. If a batch flushes due to deadline while the goroutine is cancelled and then retried, we can end up returning an empty slice for some indices. Seen in go-sdk v0.9.2.

maria-csr: Customer is using go-sdk v0.9.2 with client-side batching enabled and timeout=500ms, batch size=16. They ramped to 5k concurrent small requests.

kelly-sre: Any stack traces or logs from the server side showing truncated payloads? Could be upstream proxy cutting body.

maria-csr: They forwarded client logs showing the SDK returned nil/len==0 for embeddings, no HTTP error. Server logs show normal 200 and payload length header appears correct.

jonathan-go: Repro steps I used locally: 
1) Use go-sdk v0.9.2
2) Configure batcher: MaxBatch=16, MinBatch=1, FlushTimeout=50ms, Concurrency=8
3) Spawn 2000 goroutines calling Embed(ctx) with a 100ms context deadline
Result: ~1.5% of responses contained zero-length embeddings.

jonathan-go: Patch idea: ensure we only map results into response slots after successful decode and length check; on decode error or context cancel return a retryable error instead of inserting empty slice. Also add metrics: embedding.dim_missing_count.

sam-engineer: Can we recommend a quick customer workaround while we triage?

jonathan-go: Yes: pin to go-sdk v0.9.0 or disable client-side batching (set BatcherEnabled=false) or increase client timeout to >1s. Also add a client-side check: if len(vec)==0 then retry request (dedupe token id to avoid double billing) — though dedupe requires server support.

maria-csr: I told customer to disable batching and increase timeout; they confirmed reduced errors but billing still had duplicates because retries already happened. They want root cause and a patch.

kelly-sre: Filed internal incident and created ticket INF-4321. support-bot: created issue INF-4321 and linked to ticket C-9931 :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Automations: added temporary rate-limit rule for the customer's org to flatten spikes.

jonathan-go: I'll open PR to the go-sdk with a failing unit test and fix. Plan: safe-write mapping + add decode guard + metrics. ETA end of day.

sam-engineer: Thx. Also add an integration test that runs with aggressive context deadlines to catch regressions. :thumbsup:

maria-csr: Keeping customer updated. Will escalate to enterprise success if billing dispute persists.

jonathan-go: Follow-up: TODOs — reproduce with same inputs, add logs for batch ids, publish mitigation patch and release v0.9.3, and coordinate release notes.

maria-csr: Noted. I'll attach repro script and the customer's permalink to C-9931 in INF-4321.

kelly-sre: Closing temporary monitor in 24h if no regressions.
